function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check open appointment slots for a service on a specific date, optionally for a specific barber. Always resolve any relative date the caller gives (e.g. 'next Monday') to an exact YYYY-MM-DD date using {{current_date}} before calling this.

date.description: Exact calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must already be resolved from any relative phrase.

staff_id.description: Optional. Omit entirely if the caller has no barber preference.

headers.x-vapi-secret: <VAPI_SHARED_SECRET -- same value as the backend's env var, set per-assistant in Vapi dashboard, never commit this>
